history_summary.value: The Padovana is an old small crested and bearded chicken from Padova in Italy's Veneto region, with crested chickens depicted in the area as far back as a 1397 fresco. Its precise origins and relationship to similar Polish and Dutch crested breeds remain debated, and it survives today in low numbers of around 1,200 birds.
